title.narrative: ASEAN Social Work Day was marked through the launch of ASEAN Guidance on“Empowering Women and Children: Delivering Quality Social Work Services for Those at Risk of or Affected by Violence”. Two key regional ASEAN guidance on social service workforce strengthening related to climate resilience and to education were finalized. The first regional dialogue bringing together representatives from national disaster management agencies and ministries of social welfare on the role of social services in climate resilience was convened to inform regional guidance and position social welfare and protection of children and women as central to disaster planning and response.
